shared_elements: low-relief carving on the face of a large upright monolith
schematic, flat-relief motif with raised outlines
angular/curved limb-like or band-like relief elements
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, flat, schematic relief motifs raised from the plane of a tall upright stone slab, and both use simple raised outlines with angular bends rather than modelled naturalism. But the depicted subjects differ entirely: A shows a single quadruped/reptilian creature in profile crawling across a blank field, while B is an anthropomorphic figure (head, torso, arms) covered with discs, rings, bands and curvilinear symbols; there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and no shared compositional scheme.
